name: AnySearch
description: Connect AnySearch for real-time web and vertical searches, batch queries, and full-page content extraction.
authorization.title: Enter an API key
authorization.description: Create an API key in the AnySearch console and enter it here. Poco uses the fixed official endpoint and encrypts the key at rest. The upstream service validates the key during queries; a successful connection does not prove key validity. Quota and billing follow your AnySearch account rules.
authorization.apiKey.label: API key
authorization.apiKey.description: Enter the AnySearch API key itself, without the Bearer prefix.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.search.title: Real-time web search
capabilities.search.description: Search web pages, news, documentation, and other public information using natural language.
capabilities.domains.title: Vertical search
capabilities.domains.description: Discover domains and parameters before searching finance, academic, code, legal, and other specialized sources.
capabilities.batch.title: Batch search
capabilities.batch.description: Run up to five queries in one call for multiple questions or research across domains.
capabilities.extract.title: Full-page extraction
capabilities.extract.description: Read the body of a URL. Supports HTML, plain text, JSON, and Markdown; binary files such as PDFs are unsupported.

examples.research.title: Find technical resources
examples.research.description: Find official FastAPI documentation and related research, then compare approaches to asynchronous request handling.
